policies.summary: Negotiate supply-security agreements with key fertiliser-exporting countries to limit disruption and export-restriction risks.

policies.title: Critical Inputs Fund for domestic fertiliser
policies.summary: Create a $10 million fund to support long-term domestic nitrogen production and a transition from natural gas to electrification.

policies.title: New Waiheke marine reserve and larger Goat Island reserve
policies.summary: Establish a new marine reserve off Waiheke Island and expand Goat Island / Te Hāwere-a-Maki Marine Reserve.

policies.title: No recreational fishing licence
policies.summary: Give recreational fishers a role in reforms and rule out a recreational fishing licence.

policies.title: Prevent commercial sale of marlin
policies.summary: Prohibit the commercial sale of marlin.

policies.title: Ban commercial fishing in Hauraki Gulf protection areas
policies.summary: Ban commercial fishing in Hauraki Gulf High Protection Areas and review designated trawl corridors.

policies.title: Fish Tech Innovation Fund
policies.summary: Create a $20 million fund for fisheries technology and innovation.

policies.title: Protect 50% of the EEZ by 2040
policies.summary: Preserve seamounts and aim to increase protected areas in the Exclusive Economic Zone from 32% to 50% by 2040.

policies.title: Keep rockpool species collection ban
policies.summary: Retain the ban on taking shellfish and marine species from rockpools and strengthen penalties and enforcement.

policies.title: More honorary officers and catch-limit penalties
policies.summary: Increase Honorary Fisheries Officers to 200 and increase penalties and infringements for exceeding catch limits.

policies.title: Require completion of Year 11
policies.summary: Require students to remain at school until they complete Year 11 or turn 16, whichever is later, unless an employment or training exemption applies.

policies.title: Consistent school start and finish dates
policies.summary: Work with schools to establish nationally consistent start and finish dates.

policies.title: Expedite visas for partners of New Zealand citizens
policies.summary: Prioritise and expedite work and visitor visas for partners of New Zealand citizens returning home.

policies.title: Restore council choice over minimum parking requirements
policies.summary: End the blanket ban on minimum parking requirements and let councils require parking outside areas identified for intensification.

policies.title: Jobs guarantee for young people
policies.summary: Guarantee a local community job pathway for every 16- to 24-year-old who wants work and has been unemployed for six months.

policies.title: Innovation Boost for productive and low-carbon investment
policies.summary: Refocus Investment Boost on productive investment aligned with industry objectives, decarbonisation and decent-work principles.

policies.title: Mission Fellowships for researchers and technical specialists
policies.summary: Create industry-objective-linked fellowships for early- and mid-career researchers and technical specialists.

policies.title: Idea to Export commercialisation pathway
policies.summary: Create a coordinated public funding pathway from experimentation and research through validation, commercialisation and scaling.

policies.title: Restore core science funding and target 3% R&D
policies.summary: Restore core science operating funding and work toward research-and-development spending of 3% of GDP.

policies.title: Use public purchasing to back New Zealand-made solutions
policies.summary: Use government procurement to support suitable New Zealand-made products and services.

policies.title: Increase tertiary research and vocational-excellence funding
policies.summary: Increase tertiary research, innovation and capacity funding, including restoring support for centres of vocational excellence.

policies.title: Keep human and democratic decision-making above AI
policies.summary: Regulate artificial intelligence so it does not replace human and democratic decision-making.

policies.title: Protect data sovereignty and community consent in AI
policies.summary: Require artificial-intelligence systems to respect data sovereignty and community consent.

policies.title: Environmental limits for artificial intelligence
policies.summary: Require artificial-intelligence development and operation to remain within environmental limits.

policies.title: Share the economic benefits of artificial intelligence
policies.summary: Regulate artificial intelligence so its benefits are shared rather than concentrated in large technology companies.

policies.title: Transparent and accountable artificial intelligence
policies.summary: Require artificial-intelligence tools to be transparent, trustworthy and accountable.

policies.title: Cut $9.5 billion a year from government spending
policies.summary: Deliver $22 billion of savings over four years, reaching $9.5 billion annually once fully implemented, outside welfare and protected frontline services.

policies.title: Reduce government to 19 departments and 18 ministers
policies.summary: Consolidate central government into 19 departments overseen by 18 ministers responsible for budgets and results.

policies.title: Remove tax on KiwiSaver investment earnings
policies.summary: Remove tax on qualifying KiwiSaver investment earnings and discontinue the government contribution.

policies.title: Carbon Tax Refund
policies.summary: Return net revenue from Emissions Trading Scheme auctions to New Zealanders through a Carbon Tax Refund.

policies.title: Raise NZ Super age to 67 by 2035
policies.summary: Gradually increase the NZ Super eligibility age to 67 by 2035, with early access for people with long careers in physically demanding work.

policies.title: Abolish rental-property loss ring-fencing
policies.summary: Allow residential rental losses incurred after the policy starts to be offset against other taxable income for existing homes and new builds; previously ring-fenced losses retain current treatment.

policies.title: Fair payment-system access for smaller financial providers
policies.summary: Require major banks to give smaller competitors fair access to payment systems and banking information.

policies.title: Digital banking licence
policies.summary: Create a proportionate licence and pathway for payments companies to develop into digital banks.

policies.title: Real-time payments for fintechs by 2030
policies.summary: Deliver secure 24-hour, seven-day real-time payments access for fintech providers by 2030.

policies.title: Government-verified identity for provider switching
policies.summary: Let customers use government-verified identity when joining or switching banks and financial providers.

policies.title: Standardised car and life insurance terms
policies.summary: Introduce clearer, more standard terms for car and life insurance so customers can compare products.

policies.title: Keep Kiwibank fully New Zealand-owned
policies.summary: Retain 100% New Zealand public ownership of Kiwibank.

policies.title: All-inclusive airline prices and pricing-data disclosure
policies.summary: Require airlines to display all-inclusive real-time fares and disclose when personal data is used to set a customer's price.

policies.title: Automatic airline refunds and delayed-baggage compensation
policies.summary: Require large airlines to provide automatic refunds for cancellations or significant changes and reimbursement for badly delayed baggage or undelivered paid services.

policies.title: Publish airline reliability performance
policies.summary: Require major airlines to publish data on delays, cancellations and baggage handling.

policies.title: Commerce Commission scrutiny of airline fares and profits
policies.summary: Require major airlines to provide the Commerce Commission with information on fares, costs and profits for regular reporting.

policies.title: Fair airport access and interline rules for smaller airlines
policies.summary: Give airlines fair access to airport gates and ground services and update connection rules so smaller airlines can reach more passengers.

policies.title: Stop airport overcharging for parking and food
policies.summary: Regulate local airport monopoly pricing for parking, food and other services.

policies.title: Lower-cost borrowing for regulated airport upgrades
policies.summary: Explore lower-cost borrowing options for regulated airports so terminal and runway investment puts less pressure on airfares.

policies.title: End sub-minimum wages for disabled workers
policies.summary: End rules that allow disabled employees to be paid less than the minimum wage.

policies.title: Support disabled people to work without losing support
policies.summary: Reform support and benefit settings so disabled people can take paid work without unfair loss of essential assistance.

policies.title: Flexible support and respite for unpaid carers
policies.summary: Improve financial security, flexible work options, respite care and future planning for unpaid family and whānau carers.

policies.title: Reinstate 2020 pay-equity rules
policies.summary: Restore the Equal Pay Amendment Act 2020 rules for disability and care-support workers.

policies.title: Tell Us Once disability-support system
policies.summary: Create a privacy-controlled Tell Us Once process and better connect disability, health, education and ACC systems.

policies.title: Improve independent-living supports
policies.summary: Review and improve home modifications, equipment services, person-led planning and supported-living pathways.

policies.title: Accessible disability complaints and rights enforcement
policies.summary: Strengthen accessible complaints, appeals and remedies when disabled people's rights are not respected.

policies.title: Accessibility across housing, transport and services
policies.summary: Progressively remove barriers from housing, transport, public buildings, digital services and employment.

policies.title: Disabled people to lead disability-policy oversight
policies.summary: Partner with disabled people's organisations and Māori disability leaders, support independent UNCRPD monitoring and report publicly on progress.

policies.title: Ban public sales and private use of fireworks
policies.summary: Ban the retail sale, manufacture and importation of fireworks for public use while continuing to allow approved public displays.

policies.title: Increase Working for Families in-work tax credit to $120 a week
policies.summary: Make the temporary $50 weekly in-work tax-credit increase permanent and add another $70, taking the total increase to $120 a week.

policies.title: Increase the minimum wage by at least inflation each year
policies.summary: Increase the minimum wage by at least the rate of inflation in every year of the next term of government.

policies.title: Replace the Accredited Employer Work Visa with a Skilled Work Visa
policies.summary: Replace the Accredited Employer Work Visa with a shortage-led visa tied to a named occupation, region and demonstrated need.

policies.title: Require infrastructure before fast-track housing approval
policies.summary: Require fast-track housing developers to show that necessary infrastructure exists, is funded and can be delivered, with council advice and panel powers to decline projects where it will not be available.

policies.title: End unused preferential fast-track listings after 2028
policies.summary: Remove preferential fast-track access from currently listed housing projects that have not lodged an application by the end of 2028, requiring any later proposal to seek referral again.

policies.title: Housing Minister to decide housing fast-track referrals
policies.summary: Make the Minister for Housing responsible for referral decisions involving fast-track housing projects.

policies.title: Affordable school uniform requirements
policies.summary: Require schools to limit compulsory branded uniform items, allow qualifying generic alternatives, consider affordability and publish uniform costs.

policies.title: Restore fresh locally made school lunches
policies.summary: Restore fresh, locally made school lunches from Term 1 of 2028.

policies.title: Restore cancelled rural school bus routes where possible
policies.summary: Restore the 43 cancelled rural school-bus routes where possible and work with communities where routes can no longer be reinstated.

policies.title: Redirect up to $50 million a year into Elevate
policies.summary: Redirect up to $50 million a year of the Government's contribution to the NZ Super Fund into Elevate to help innovative New Zealand businesses expand and employ people domestically.

policies.title: Help small businesses and start-ups use artificial intelligence
policies.summary: Help small businesses and start-ups adopt artificial-intelligence tools intended to save time and improve productivity.

policies.title: Permit off-the-shelf plug-in solar panels
policies.summary: Allow shops to sell plug-in solar panels off the shelf within the first six months of a re-elected National Government.

policies.title: National standard for farm plans
policies.summary: Create one consistent, practical and risk-based national standard for identifying and managing environmental risks through farm plans.

policies.title: National standard for vegetable growing
policies.summary: Create a national vegetable-growing standard, including permitted activity status where specified conditions are met.

policies.title: National standard for farm drain maintenance
policies.summary: Create a national standard allowing farmers to clear and maintain existing drains under consistent rules.

policies.title: National standard for farm effluent management
policies.summary: Set consistent nationwide requirements for storing and applying farm effluent while protecting the environment.

policies.title: National standard for fertiliser application
policies.summary: Set nationally consistent fertiliser-application rules intended to support productivity while protecting waterways.

policies.title: National standard for wetlands
policies.summary: Create a national wetlands standard intended to simplify rules and reduce uncertainty for farmers.

policies.title: National standard for seasonal-worker accommodation
policies.summary: Create a national standard, modelled on granny-flat rules, for small-scale seasonal-worker accommodation on farms and orchards.

policies.title: National standard for farm tracks
policies.summary: Create a national standard for building and maintaining farm tracks, with erosion and sediment controls.

policies.title: National standard for agricultural aviation
policies.summary: Create consistent national rules for farm airstrips, aerial topdressing and agricultural spraying.

policies.title: National standard for culverts
policies.summary: Set national requirements for installing and replacing basic culverts used by stock and vehicles to cross waterways.

policies.title: National standard for offal holes
policies.summary: Create consistent national rules for disposing of dead stock and offal on farms without requiring consent.

policies.title: Rework the contaminated-soils national standard
policies.summary: Rework the national standard for contaminated soils to provide a consistent approach to legacy contamination while keeping land safe to use.

policies.title: Duty to disclose information when a child is killed
policies.summary: Create an offence, punishable by up to 10 years in prison, for failing to disclose relevant information when present where a child aged 12 or younger was killed, subject to exceptional-circumstance safeguards.

policies.title: School Start Check for every child
policies.summary: Introduce a School Start Check before each child transitions from early childhood education to primary school.

policies.title: ECE developmental milestones and parent reporting
policies.summary: Establish clearer developmental milestones throughout early childhood education and report each child's progress to parents.

policies.title: Expanded Early Intervention Service referrals
policies.summary: Identify children needing additional support before school and connect them with an expanded Early Intervention Service.

policies.title: End screen use in ECE and limit primary-school devices
policies.summary: End screen and individual-device use in early childhood education, tightly limit it in Years 1 to 3, and set age-appropriate limits for older primary students.

policies.title: Paper-based primary writing assessments
policies.summary: Require the writing component of twice-yearly primary-school assessments to be completed on paper.

policies.title: Learning Support Coordinators in all Year 1-8 schools
policies.summary: Provide Learning Support Coordinators in all schools with Year 1 to 8 students from 2028.

policies.title: Two million extra teacher-aide hours a year
policies.summary: Build to two million additional teacher-aide hours each year from 2028 and provide training for behavioural, emotional and neurodiverse needs.

policies.title: More warm and dry classrooms
policies.summary: Deliver more warm, dry classrooms and seek better value from school-property investment.

policies.title: Free up 4.5 million GP appointments a year
policies.summary: Support phone triage, patient information and paperwork-reducing technology through a Digital Innovation Fund to free up around 4.5 million GP appointments annually.

policies.title: Public Health Agency to set the vaccine schedule
policies.summary: Put the Public Health Agency in charge of deciding the national vaccine schedule and eligibility while Pharmac continues price and supply negotiations.

policies.title: Restore national and regional winter health planning
policies.summary: Restart winter health planning and publish national and regional warnings so services can prepare staffing and capacity.

policies.title: End the Health New Zealand hiring freeze
policies.summary: End the Health New Zealand hiring freeze so hospitals can recruit needed staff.

policies.title: Open staffed hospital beds and improve patient flow
policies.summary: Identify unopened hospital beds and required staff, and address bottlenecks that delay admission and discharge.

policies.title: Subsidise extended-care paramedic training
policies.summary: Subsidise extended-care paramedic training and improve pathways so more paramedics can qualify to treat people outside hospital.

policies.title: Clinical telehealth advice service
policies.summary: Establish a clinical telehealth service giving paramedics, rural GPs, aged-care staff and other professionals access to urgent-care or emergency doctors.

policies.title: Longer emergency prescription medicine supplies
policies.summary: Review rules so pharmacists can continue an existing prescription beyond the current 72-hour emergency limit, with safeguards and a maximum supply period.

policies.title: Early supported discharge teams in every region
policies.summary: Fund teams in every region to provide short-term nursing, rehabilitation and practical support for older people recovering at home.

policies.title: Improve more than 2,000 school properties
policies.summary: Allocate about $450 million to improve buildings and grounds at more than 2,000 state and integrated schools.

policies.title: Clear the hospital repair backlog
policies.summary: Allocate $200 million and direct Health New Zealand to complete existing hospital remediation projects.

policies.title: Restart Kāinga Ora social-house building
policies.summary: Allocate $2.9 billion of capital for Kāinga Ora to resume building social housing, with associated operating funding for Kāinga Ora and community providers.

policies.title: Continue Active Me-Kia Tū sport grants
policies.summary: Provide $3 million a year for four years to continue grants of up to $300 a year for two years toward children's sport and recreation costs.

policies.title: Extra funding for after-school sport and activities
policies.summary: Add $4 million a year through Tū Manawa Active Aotearoa, ring-fenced for community groups providing children's after-school activities.

policies.title: Mandatory school screen-use policies
policies.summary: Update national age-based screen guidance and require school and kura boards to adopt clear classroom screen-use policies.

policies.title: Ban social-media accounts for under-16s
policies.summary: Make social-media companies legally responsible for preventing children under 16 from holding accounts, with privacy safeguards for age checks.

policies.title: Choice between personalised and followed-account feeds
policies.summary: Require social-media companies to let users aged 16 and over choose between personalised recommendations and posts only from followed accounts.

policies.title: Digital Duty of Care for online services
policies.summary: Introduce legal duties requiring online services to identify and address risks, with stronger protections for under-18s and against deepfake abuse.

policies.title: Progressive Procurement target for Māori businesses
policies.summary: Reinstate Progressive Procurement with an initial target for 5% of government contracts to be allocated to Māori businesses.

policies.title: Living Wage across the public service
policies.summary: Require the Living Wage for directly employed departmental workers and at least the Living Wage across the public service and publicly owned organisations.

policies.title: Require employers to publish group pay gaps
policies.summary: Require employers to publish pay gaps between different groups of their staff.

policies.title: Restore Fair Pay Agreements
policies.summary: Introduce Fair Pay Agreements legislation within the first 100 days of government.

policies.title: Collective agreements by default
policies.summary: Make collective employment agreements the default while allowing workers to choose an individual agreement.

policies.title: Protect employment terms when businesses or contracts transfer
policies.summary: Protect existing employee terms and conditions when a business is sold or a service contract changes hands.

policies.title: Ban most employment non-compete clauses
policies.summary: Ban most non-compete clauses in employment agreements.

policies.title: Reinstate leave removed by Holidays Act changes
policies.summary: Reinstate employee leave entitlements removed by Holidays Act changes.

policies.title: Stronger protections for gig and platform workers
policies.summary: Reject the worker-status gateway test, strengthen protections for gig and platform workers, and work toward ratifying ILO Convention 193.

policies.title: Corporate homicide offence
policies.summary: Create a corporate homicide offence as part of stronger workplace health and safety law.

policies.title: Ratify ILO Convention 190
policies.summary: Ratify the International Labour Organization convention on violence and harassment at work.

policies.title: Three-month repayment rule for retirement villages
policies.summary: Require retirement villages to repay departing residents within three months, including existing residents.

policies.title: Independent retirement-village dispute service
policies.summary: Establish a simple, accessible and independent dispute-resolution service for retirement-village residents.

policies.title: Crown guarantee for community housing finance
policies.summary: Provide a $950 million Crown guarantee for the Community Housing Funding Agency from the first Budget in 2027.

policies.title: Enabling Good Lives impact assessments
policies.summary: Require government agencies to publish Enabling Good Lives impact assessments, targets and actions.

policies.title: Reasonable accommodation recognised in human-rights law
policies.summary: Amend the Human Rights Act to define reasonable accommodation and recognise denial of it as discrimination.

policies.title: Progress UN disability convention into domestic law
policies.summary: Progress incorporating the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities into New Zealand law.

policies.title: Replace the Disability Support Services Act
policies.summary: Repeal the Disability Support Services Act and develop a rights-based replacement framework with disabled people, carers and their organisations.

policies.title: End annual benefit renewals for verified permanent disabilities
policies.summary: End annual benefit renewal requirements for people with verified permanent disabilities.

policies.title: At least 25% of new Kāinga Ora homes accessible
policies.summary: Require at least 25% of new Kāinga Ora homes to meet accessibility requirements.

policies.title: Affirm Te Whāriki and refresh the ECE strategy
policies.summary: Affirm Te Whāriki, continue the Early Learning Action Plan and refresh the ten-year early-childhood strategy.

policies.title: Work toward ECE teacher pay parity
policies.summary: Work toward genuine pay parity between early-childhood teachers and other teachers.

policies.title: Stronger ECE ratios and smaller group sizes
policies.summary: Introduce stronger teacher-to-child ratios and smaller group sizes in early childhood education.

policies.title: Restore ECE network planning
policies.summary: Restore early-childhood network planning and support community-based, smaller and parent-led providers.

policies.title: Unannounced ECE checks and stronger transparency
policies.summary: Strengthen ECE oversight through unannounced checks, clearer financial reporting and an improved complaints process.

policies.title: Restore a genuine Emissions Trading Scheme price
policies.summary: Urgently reform the Emissions Trading Scheme to maintain a genuine emissions price and invest resulting revenue in affordable energy and resilience.

policies.title: Remain committed to the Paris Agreement
policies.summary: Remain in the Paris Agreement and put New Zealand on a path to meet its emissions targets.

policies.title: Paid compulsory placements for essential-service students
policies.summary: Pay students $380 a week, in addition to existing student support, during compulsory placements in nursing, teaching, social work and other essential sectors.

policies.title: Relocation payment for compulsory placements
policies.summary: Provide a $1,500 payment toward relocation costs for students who must move for a compulsory placement.

policies.title: Abolish the training wage
policies.summary: Abolish the training wage for apprentices and trainees.

policies.title: $2,000 apprentice equipment grant
policies.summary: Provide apprentices with a $2,000 grant over their apprenticeship for tools, uniforms and course materials.

policies.title: Māori and Pasifika-led apprenticeship support
policies.summary: Provide an annual $30 million uplift for Māori and Pasifika-led apprenticeship training, job matching and wraparound support.

policies.title: Apprenticeship completion bonus for employers
policies.summary: Pay employers a $2,000 bonus when they actively support apprentices to progress through their qualifications.

policies.title: Expand the Game Development Sector Rebate
policies.summary: Increase the game-development rebate from 20% to 40%, lift the claim cap to $10 million, lower the entry threshold to $150,000 and increase annual funding to $45 million by 2028.

policies.title: Long-term funding for the Centre of Digital Excellence
policies.summary: Baseline the Centre of Digital Excellence budget at $5 million a year and increase it to $7 million by 2028.

policies.title: Canterbury commuter-rail trial
policies.summary: Run a 12-month commuter-rail trial between Rolleston and Christchurch and between Rangiora and Christchurch.

policies.title: Reinstate the Southerner passenger train
policies.summary: Work with the Mainlander operator to restore the Southerner passenger service connecting Christchurch, Dunedin and Invercargill.

policies.title: Safeguards for imported aluminium extrusions
policies.summary: Reverse the decision not to impose a safeguard measure on imported aluminium extrusions before the end of 2026.

policies.title: Statutory Combat Sports Commission
policies.summary: Create a statutory commission to license combat-sports events and contestants, set medical standards and penalise illegal or unsanctioned events.

policies.title: Increase Crown funding for Coastguard to 70%
policies.summary: Increase Crown funding to 70% of Coastguard operating costs, an estimated increase of $12 million a year.

policies.title: Emergency-response funding and coordination review
policies.summary: Review emergency-service coordination and volunteer support, and investigate an Emergency Response Capital Grants Fund for charitable responders.

policies.title: Accredited Security Operators with additional powers
policies.summary: Create accredited security operators who may remove people threatening safety, require identification, detain people in specified circumstances until Police arrive and issue multi-premises exclusion notices, subject to training and safeguards.

policies.title: 1,000 additional teacher aides
policies.summary: Invest $80 million over four years for 1,000 additional teacher aides, simplify school funding for greater certainty and follow up the Highest Needs Review to improve access to learning support.

policies.title: Financial literacy in the school curriculum
policies.summary: Ensure financial literacy is part of the school curriculum.

policies.title: Easier child bank-account opening
policies.summary: Progress Anti-Money Laundering law changes to make opening a child bank account simpler for parents.

policies.title: Three-day postnatal stays
policies.summary: Roll out three-day postnatal stays for mothers and newborns.

policies.title: Reserve Housing Flexible Fund places for seniors
policies.summary: Ring-fence at least 20% of places funded through the Housing Flexible Fund for seniors housing.

policies.title: Expand granny-flat building rules
policies.summary: Extend and simplify the granny-flat rules so more granny flats can be built faster and at lower cost.

policies.title: Extend granny-flat rules to tiny homes
policies.summary: Extend the simplified granny-flat building rules to tiny homes.

policies.title: 0800 Seniors helpline
policies.summary: Establish a single free 0800 Seniors helpline to help older people navigate government services and entitlements.

policies.title: Review Enduring Powers of Attorney protections
policies.summary: Review the Enduring Powers of Attorney framework and consider law changes to better protect seniors from elder abuse and financial exploitation.

policies.title: Expand the Maths Acceleration Programme
policies.summary: Add 40,000 students over three years to the Years 7-10 Maths Acceleration Programme, reaching about 128,200 students by 2029.

policies.title: Retain the school phone ban
policies.summary: Keep the ban on student mobile-phone use in schools.

policies.title: Advance the Online Safety Bill
policies.summary: Pass the first reading of the Online Safety (Minimum Age and Child Safety Risk Assessment) Bill and progress it to select committee.

policies.title: Ban taxpayer funding for gangs
policies.summary: Adopt legislation preventing taxpayer money from being used to fund gangs.

policies.title: 50% first-year accelerated depreciation
policies.summary: Allow manufacturing and targeted export-sector businesses to deduct 50% in the first year for new plant, machinery and equipment.

policies.title: Remove ETS costs from petrol and diesel
policies.summary: Remove Emissions Trading Scheme costs from fuel, which the party estimates would reduce petrol by 12 cents a litre and diesel by 14 cents.

policies.title: Dedicated organised-crime agency
policies.summary: Establish a dedicated agency and responsible minister to dismantle organised and transnational criminal networks.

policies.title: Replace the Serious Fraud Office with a Police division
policies.summary: Abolish the Serious Fraud Office and replace it with a specialised division inside New Zealand Police.

policies.title: Mandatory minimum sentences for serious offending
policies.summary: Increase the use of mandatory minimum sentences for serious violent and sexual offenders.

policies.title: State-funded immediate victim reparation
policies.summary: Have the state pay immediate reparation to victims and recover the money from offenders.

policies.title: Increase maximum sentences for attempted murder and grievous harm
policies.summary: Raise the maximum sentence for attempted murder and wounding with intent to cause grievous bodily harm from 14 to 25 years.

policies.title: Degrees of murder regime
policies.summary: Create first-, second- and third-degree murder categories with specified life sentences and non-parole periods.

policies.title: Cap most sentence discounts at 10%
policies.summary: Limit sentencing discounts other than a guilty plea to 10%, while retaining a maximum guilty-plea discount of 25%.

policies.title: Raise standard parole eligibility to 75%
policies.summary: Require long-term offenders to serve 75% of their sentence before standard parole eligibility and require people convicted of murder to be assessed as low risk before release.

policies.title: Eight-year non-parole minimum for fatal coward punches
policies.summary: Require an eight-year minimum non-parole period for a coward punch causing death.

policies.title: Review transport penalty settings
policies.summary: Review transport fines, demerits and court requirements for consistency and effectiveness.

policies.title: Oppose extending the Clean Slate law
policies.summary: Oppose any further extension of the Clean Slate law.

policies.title: Publish sentencing notes within 72 hours
policies.summary: Require District Courts to proactively publish sentencing notes within 72 hours.

policies.title: Restrict final name suppression
policies.summary: Limit final name suppression to extreme cases.

policies.title: Treat home burglary as aggravated burglary
policies.summary: Treat burglary of a home or private dwelling in the same way as aggravated burglary or home invasion.

policies.title: Stronger safeguards for home and business self-defence
policies.summary: Change Police and prosecution guidance so people who use excessive force while defending themselves or others in a home or business are treated as victims unless there is overwhelming evidence otherwise, and require Solicitor-General review before prosecution.

policies.title: Investigate Castle Doctrine and Stand Your Ground laws
policies.summary: Investigate implementing Castle Doctrine and Stand Your Ground protections for people defending themselves and their property.

policies.title: Operating allowances of $4.5b to $4.7b
policies.summary: Set future government operating allowances at $4.5 billion to $4.7 billion a year during the forecast period.

policies.title: Green fiscal targets
policies.summary: Return the operating balance to a $0.4 billion surplus in 2029/30, with net core Crown debt at 44% of GDP by 2030/31 and Crown expenses and revenue near 40% of GDP.

policies.title: Establish a Parliamentary Budget Office
policies.summary: Create a Parliamentary Budget Office to independently cost party policies.

policies.title: Long-term health workforce plan
policies.summary: Fund a long-term plan to train, recruit and retain doctors, specialists, nurses, allied-health workers and support staff.

policies.title: Strengthen primary, preventive and community care
policies.summary: Increase investment in primary, preventive and community healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals.

policies.title: Implement hospitality regulation reforms
policies.summary: Pass the Sale and Supply of Alcohol (Improving Alcohol Regulation) Amendment Bill and implement the Hospitality Review recommendations.

policies.title: Industry safety codes as safe harbours
policies.summary: Approve industry health-and-safety codes as safe harbours under the new health-and-safety law.

policies.title: Software and digital-investment deductions
policies.summary: Provide clearer tax deductions for software and digital investment.

policies.title: Rules and trials for digital financial assets
policies.summary: Create clear rules for stablecoins and tokenised assets, supervised trials and a 12-month bright-line for qualifying personal investments.

policies.title: Restore carbon assistance for trade-exposed industries
policies.summary: Restore carbon-cost assistance where overseas competitors face lower emissions costs.

policies.title: Stronger ministerial powers over department heads
policies.summary: Give ministers stronger powers to appoint and remove departmental chief executives for poor performance.

policies.title: Reduce forecast debt by $12.4 billion
policies.summary: Reduce forecast government debt by $12.4 billion by 2031.

policies.title: Return foreign-aid spending to 2017 levels
policies.summary: Reduce foreign-aid spending to 2017 levels, saving about $283 million a year, while protecting support for Ukraine and focusing aid on New Zealand interests including the Pacific.

policies.title: Additional $400m for general practice
policies.summary: Invest an additional $400 million in general practice over four years.

policies.title: Streamline overseas-doctor registration
policies.summary: Remove unnecessary registration barriers so qualified overseas doctors can practise sooner.

policies.title: Retain and strengthen health targets
policies.summary: Keep the Government health targets and drive further improvements, particularly in emergency-department waiting times.

policies.title: Pharmacy skin-lesion triage
policies.summary: Allow trained pharmacists to image suspicious skin lesions, use approved risk-assessment technology and refer concerning cases for diagnosis.

policies.title: Reduce pharmacy opening and licensing barriers
policies.summary: Remove unnecessary restrictions on opening pharmacies and extend pharmacy licence-renewal periods.

policies.title: Relocatable anti-social noise cameras
policies.summary: Deploy relocatable noise cameras in persistent problem areas to support enforcement against anti-social vehicle noise.

policies.title: Criminalise non-consensual deepfake pornography
policies.summary: Create an offence for non-consensual deepfake pornography.

policies.title: End good-character discounts for child-sex offending
policies.summary: Prevent good character from reducing sentences for people convicted of child-sex offences.

policies.title: Prevent courts creating unlegislated Treaty duties
policies.summary: Stop courts creating Treaty duties that Parliament has not legislated and require new laws to state Treaty obligations clearly.

policies.title: Limit tikanga in court decisions
policies.summary: Allow tikanga to be used in court decisions only where Parliament has expressly authorised it.

policies.title: Keep public-service spiritual practices voluntary
policies.summary: Make spiritual practices voluntary and end the use of public-service time and funding for them.

policies.title: Four-year parliamentary-term referendum in 2029
policies.summary: Complete four-year-term legislation so voters can decide the issue at a referendum in 2029.

policies.title: Abolish the Broadcasting Standards Authority
policies.summary: Disestablish the Broadcasting Standards Authority rather than extend broadcasting rules to podcasts and online media.

policies.title: 10,000 charter-school enrolments by 2029
policies.summary: Reach 10,000 student enrolments in charter schools by the end of 2029.

policies.title: School trade subjects and Industry Awards
policies.summary: Remove funding caps from approved school trade subjects and introduce Industry Awards alongside University Entrance.

policies.title: Mandatory action after assaults at school
policies.summary: Require removal and a stand-down or suspension after a school assault, with Police referral where warranted.

policies.title: $500 investment account for Year 11 students
policies.summary: Give every Year 11 student a controlled investment account seeded with $500, progressing from term deposits to managed funds and shares as financial understanding develops.

policies.title: New co-educational high school at Epsom campus
policies.summary: Secure the University of Auckland Epsom campus for a new co-educational high school while protecting existing school zones.

policies.title: Complete replacement of NCEA
policies.summary: Complete the replacement of NCEA with clearer, more rigorous subject-based qualifications.

policies.title: Complete ECE licensing and compliance reforms
policies.summary: Complete reforms to reduce unnecessary early-childhood licensing and compliance costs.

policies.title: Independent-school subsidy parity
policies.summary: Keep independent-school subsidy increases aligned with state-school operational-funding increases.

policies.title: Retain Agricultural and Horticultural Science in Year 11
policies.summary: Keep Agricultural and Horticultural Science as a standalone Year 11 subject.

policies.title: National standards for routine farm work
policies.summary: Use national standards to reduce one-off consenting for routine farm work.

policies.title: National method for freshwater limits
policies.summary: Create a national method for setting freshwater limits using measurable environmental outcomes.

policies.title: Remove spiritual tests from consenting
policies.summary: Remove spiritual tests and compulsory religious observances from consenting processes.

policies.title: Reward housing growth and enable private infrastructure finance
policies.summary: Reward councils for housing growth and enable private infrastructure financing for growing communities.

policies.title: Publish the lowest-cost safe transport option
policies.summary: Require transport projects to publish the lowest-cost safe option alongside the preferred design.

policies.title: Traffic thresholds for route capacity
policies.summary: Set traffic thresholds for route protection, additional capacity planning and construction starts.

policies.title: Protect transport maintenance funding
policies.summary: Prioritise potholes, drainage and bridges by protecting maintenance funding and excluding non-functional art and decorative extras.

policies.title: Infrastructure contracts based on value and capability
policies.summary: Require infrastructure contracts to be awarded on value and capability rather than ethnicity.

policies.title: Citizenship test
policies.summary: Introduce a citizenship test covering New Zealand rights, freedoms and responsibilities.

policies.title: Dedicated overstayer enforcement unit
policies.summary: Create a dedicated overstayer enforcement unit, strengthen work-right checks and penalise employers who facilitate overstaying.

policies.title: Annual evidence for work-visa skill categories
policies.summary: Require annual evidence of demand for Accredited Employer Work Visa skill categories.

policies.title: Broader basic-English requirements
policies.summary: Extend basic-English requirements for migrants, with a lower standard for seasonal workers.

policies.title: Five-year benefit stand-down for new residents
policies.summary: Apply a five-year stand-down before new residence-class visa holders can receive income-tested benefits.

policies.title: Proportionate health-and-safety duties for volunteers
policies.summary: Keep volunteer and community-group health-and-safety duties clear, proportionate and free of unnecessary burdens.

policies.title: Remembrance Army service-grave programme
policies.summary: Back the Remembrance Army with consistent national rules and up to $1 million to restore neglected service graves and clear the backlog.

policies.title: Ban no-cause evictions
policies.summary: Require landlords to give a valid reason for ending a tenancy.

policies.title: Longer notice for landlord move-in, sale or renovation
policies.summary: Require 63 days' notice when a landlord or family member will move in, and 90 days for sale, renovation or a change of use.

policies.title: Landlord duty of care for serious hazards
policies.summary: Introduce a landlord duty of care to address serious hazards in rental homes.

policies.title: Curtains and blinds under Healthy Homes Standards
policies.summary: Require proper curtains or blinds under the Healthy Homes Standards.

policies.title: Limit insurer-required rental inspections
policies.summary: Stop insurers requiring routine rental inspections more often than every six months.

policies.title: Property-manager regulation
policies.summary: Set clear rules for property managers so tenants and landlords are treated fairly.

policies.title: Stronger boarding-house oversight
policies.summary: Strengthen oversight of boarding houses to better protect residents.

policies.title: Rent-to-buy pathway for public and community housing tenants
policies.summary: Introduce rent-to-buy for eligible Kāinga Ora and participating community-housing tenants who are working and ready to move towards ownership.

policies.title: Trust accounts for rent-to-buy deposit credits
policies.summary: Hold rent-to-buy deposit credits safely in trust accounts.

policies.title: Expand First Home Loans to a $300,000 income cap
policies.summary: Lift the First Home Loan income cap to $300,000, retain the five-percent deposit requirement and bring more banks into the scheme.

policies.title: Replace each public home sold through rent-to-buy with three homes
policies.summary: For every public home sold through rent-to-buy, require Kāinga Ora to build three more and reinvest the proceeds in public housing.

policies.title: Index the minimum wage to inflation
policies.summary: Increase the minimum wage in line with inflation to protect workers’ purchasing power.

policies.title: Deliver the 2027–2030 Rail Network Investment Programme
policies.summary: Deliver the $1.135 billion Rail Network Investment Programme backed by Budget 2026 and track-user charges.

policies.title: Build the Marsden Point Rail Link
policies.summary: Connect Northport to the national rail network through the Marsden Point Rail Link.

policies.title: Unlock capacity through the Kaimai Tunnel
policies.summary: Ventilate the Kaimai Tunnel and build passing loops to enable more freight trains and future passenger services.

policies.title: Reform Auckland and Wellington metropolitan rail
policies.summary: Establish co-owned Auckland Rail and Wellington Rail companies responsible for metropolitan rail infrastructure and passenger trains.

policies.title: Make Te Huia permanent
policies.summary: Extend the Hamilton–Auckland passenger service beyond 2027 and add three modern train units.

policies.title: Back permanent passenger rail in Christchurch
policies.summary: If the 12-month trial demonstrates sufficient patronage and value, establish the Christchurch passenger service permanently with government co-funding.

policies.title: Continue removing dangerous level crossings
policies.summary: Progress further Auckland level-crossing removals and upgrades and improve protection at high-risk crossings nationally.

policies.title: Deliver the new Cook Strait ferries
policies.summary: Deliver the road-and-rail ferries Kupe and Cook and associated port infrastructure for service in 2029.

policies.title: Plan Auckland’s third and fourth main lines and protect the Avondale–Southdown rail corridor
policies.summary: Begin planning Auckland’s third and fourth main lines and protect the Avondale–Southdown corridor for future passenger and freight services.

policies.title: Protect heritage rail
policies.summary: Continue discounted network access for heritage operators and provide $500,000 annually to the Rail Heritage Trust.
